permissions.notificationsTitle: Stay on top of your trips
permissions.notificationsBody: Get trip reminders before you leave, price-drop alerts for what you watch, and suggestions nearby while you travel. You can turn each one off in Settings.

rules.title: Community rules
rules.body: Be kind and keep it about travel. No spam, harassment or personal details. Reports and blocks are always available, and posts may be reviewed.
